issue:
There is a bug in this codebase. It seems to be related to the following files:
- astroid/nodes/_base_nodes.py

Please look into these files and resolve the issue. I believe a test case is also failing because of this bug:
tests/test_inference.py::InferenceTest::test_do_import_module_performance

actions.old_string:
# If the module ImportNode is importing is a module with the same name
        # as the file that contains the ImportNode we don't want to use the cache
        # to make sure we use the import system to get the correct module.
        # pylint: disable-next=no-member # pylint doesn't recognize type of mymodule
        if mymodule.relative_to_absolute_name(modname, level) == mymodule.name:
            use_cache = False
        else:
            use_cache = True
actions.new_string:
# If the module ImportNode is importing is a module with the same name
        # as the file that contains the ImportNode we don't want to use the cache
        # to make sure we use the import system to get the correct module.
        # However, if modname is empty, we should always use the cache.
        # pylint: disable-next=no-member # pylint doesn't recognize type of mymodule
        if modname and mymodule.relative_to_absolute_name(modname, level) == mymodule.name:
            use_cache = False
        else:
            use_cache = True
